Lonza is looking for new staff to join its growing GMP Warehouse and Logistics team! As a world leading contract development and manufacturing organisation (CDMO) Lonza is looking to people with a passion to help others and committed to delivering excellence for our customers patients. Our mission is to bring life changing medicines to patients and that requires a strong team with a passion for quality and excellence. If you are looking for a dynamic job where you can proudly make a difference for patient lives, take a look at our Warehouse and Logistics job openings to join our growing team at Lonza Netherlands. About Lonza: At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone's ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that's the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're ready to help turn our customers' breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now! What we are looking for: Technical education or equivalent experience, preferably with a background in science or logistics. Preferably, some experience in a clean environment, e.g. nursing, pharmacy, HACCP-regulated environments/restaurants, or a general understanding of working in a sterile environment. Entry-level experience (1–4 years) in manufacturing, science, logistics, or a related environment. Business-level English communication skills, both written and verbal. Ability to work effectively in a GMP-regulatedmanufacturing environment. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize routine and repetitive tasks while maintaining quality. A collaborative, adaptable, and proactive approach with a commitment to safety, quality, and continuous learning. Hands-on mentality. What you will get: An agile career and dynamic working culture An inclusive and ethical workplace where your ideas are valued Compensation programs that recognize high performance A comprehensive range of benefits based on your role and location Opportunities to develop your technical expertise in GMP manufacturing and advanced therapy production A collaborative team environment focused on continuous improvement. €2,650 - €2,850 gross per month, depending on experience. 8% Holiday allowance and 8% bonus. Functieomschrijving As a Warehouse and Logistics associate we handle the supply chain. From incoming goods receipt and storage and final product shipments, supporting our production teams to make life changing medicine. This is a fully site-based role. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. This role is on a rotating shift including days and night and weekends more details available. What you will do: Performing activities related to goods receipt, labelling, storage and general inventory management within a validated GMP inventory management system (SAP). Incoming patient material handling and receipt (Apheresis/Leukopak/etc.) and ensuring accurate record of chain of identity. Performing final product commercial packing and shipping activities and samples shipments following good distribution practices and GMP compliance. Completion and review of GMP documentation ensuring. Use of GMP systems daily to complete activities. Do you enjoy working with systems, solving operational challenges and improving processes? Make an impact as a Business Support Specialist! Wie zoeken we? As a Business Support Specialist, you are someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex situations. You take initiative, think ahead and know how to translate operational challenges into practical improvements. You also enjoy helping colleagues, sharing knowledge and working with different departments to achieve the best results. A bachelor's degree or equivalent working and thinking level Experience in a similar position, such as Key User, Business Support Specialist, Process Specialist, Super User or Logistics Engineer Experience with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) or comparable operational software Strong analytical skills and experience with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. Knowledge of Power BI is an advantage Good communication skills and a good command of English Wat bieden wij je? You will work in a modern, highly automated logistics environment where technology and innovation play an important role. There is plenty of room to develop your expertise and take on new challenges. A gross monthly salary between €3.000 and €4.100 based on 40 hours, depending on your experience A Time for Time arrangement 25 vacation days, with the option to increase this to 28 A company laptop and mobile phone An attractive pension scheme and travel allowance Various employee benefits, including discounts on gym memberships and a bicycle scheme You will start with a temporary contract, with the prospect of permanent employment. Functieomschrijving As a Business Support Specialist, you are responsible for ensuring that operational systems function effectively and support the daily logistics processes. You act as the main point of contact for questions and issues related to the Warehouse Management System (WMS), helping Operations make optimal use of the available systems. You work closely with Operations, IT andother departments to identify areas for improvement and turn business requirements into workable system solutions. You also play an important role in introducing system changes, from coordinating and testing updates to supporting colleagues during implementation. Supporting end users with WMS related questions and system issues Identifying inefficiencies and proposing improvements to existing processes Translating operational requirements into functional requests for IT Coordinating, testing and monitoring system changes Training colleagues and supporting them when new functionalities are introduce; Contributing to projects focused on automation, process optimization and operational efficiency The position is carried out in a 2 shift operation. Because the location is new, you will have the opportunity to help shape processes and ways of working from the start. As you develop your knowledge of the operation and systems, there are opportunities to grow further within the organization. Ready to put your analytical skills, system knowledge and problem solving mindset to work? Apply now for the Business Support Specialist position in Lelystad.
